description: Opt-in grouping for stacks whose parts must move together. Extend it LAST, after the base or */default presets: it only appends packageRules and does not extend any other preset.

packageRules.description: Update all ReportPortal images in one branch: the services share one database schema and API, so a single-image bump leaves the stack unhealthy. All major hops land in one branch instead of one branch per target major.
ReportPortal major updates need explicit Dependency Dashboard approval and are never automerged

Group the Django stack for every update type, not only majors, so a framework bump and its companion packages land in the same branch: one branch for minor, patch and digest updates and one for major updates. separateMajorMinor stays on so a pending major never hides the newest minor.
